name: Tōei (Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Tōei town emblem in white: a stylised eight-pointed device enclosing a ring with a stylised mountain.
history: Municipal flag of Tōei, a town in Aichi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 6 February 1957.

features.role: Tōei town emblem — a stylised eight-pointed device enclosing a ring with a stylised mountain
